subject: Phase 100210 Hygiene Audit and Confirmed Cleanup Implementation
verdict_justification: Core noise scoring, read-only audit scanning, confirmed cleanup with dry-run default, secret masking on previews/logs, and durable log persistence are implemented and tested on both backends. However, duplicate target IDs cause an unhandled database primary key collision in clean, preflight validation for discard reasons misses the keep action, and 8 new Rust files omit the mandatory AGENTS.md responsibility header block.

findings.title: Primary key collision in append_log on duplicate target item IDs crashes clean
findings.recommendation: Include the target iteration index or a monotonic counter in the log entry ID (e.g. format!("hlg-{}-{}-{index}", args.batch_id, target.item_id)), or deduplicate / reject duplicate target item IDs during target validation.

issues.title: Primary key collision in append_log on duplicate target item IDs crashes clean
issues.why_it_matters: append_log generates entry IDs as format!("hlg-{}-{}", args.batch_id, target.item_id). If a target item ID appears multiple times in args.targets, the second insert into hygiene_audit_logs violates the primary key constraint.
issues.impact: In dry-run mode, clean fails with an unhandled database error instead of returning counts. In confirmed mode, an unhandled database error bubbles up via ? after previous mutations were committed, leaving mutations applied without structured abort reporting.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-hygiene/src/clean.rs:301: id: format!("hlg-{}-{}", args.batch_id, target.item_id); verified with sqlite UNIQUE constraint failed on duplicate insertion.
issues.proposed_fix: Include the target iteration index in the generated log ID (format!("hlg-{}-{}-{index}", args.batch_id, target.item_id)) or deduplicate target item IDs during preflight validation.

issues.title: Preflight validation for confirmed discard reason bypasses CleanAction::Keep
issues.why_it_matters: Line 165 only checks args.action == CleanAction::Discard when validating non-empty reason. When action is Keep, individual targets can resolve to Discard.
issues.impact: If an operator calls confirmed clean with keep and an empty reason, validation passes initially, but when the first target resolved to Discard is processed, store.discard_item fails, aborting the batch mid-flight after earlier targets were mutated.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-hygiene/src/clean.rs:165: if args.confirm && args.action == CleanAction::Discard && args.reason.trim().is_empty()
issues.proposed_fix: Extend preflight check to verify non-empty reason if args.action == CleanAction::Discard || (args.action == CleanAction::Keep && args.targets.iter().any(|t| t.suggested_action.as_deref() == Some("discard"))).

issues.title: Missing AGENTS.md responsibility and boundary header in production module and new test files
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md mandates the standard header structure (//! # Responsibility, ## Owns, ## Does not own, ## Boundary) for every Rust source file created or refactored.
issues.impact: Violates repository architectural conventions and AGENTS.md hard constraints. New production module crates/clio-store/src/hygiene_seq.rs and 7 new test files omit the header block.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/hygiene_seq.rs:1-15 contains only a one-line doc comment. Test files audit_edge_tests.rs, audit_tests.rs, clean_tests.rs, detect_tests.rs, scoring_tests.rs, hygiene_tools_tests.rs, and pg_hygiene_tests.rs lack the Responsibility block.
issues.proposed_fix: Add the full AGENTS.md header block with module responsibility and ownership boundaries to crates/clio-store/src/hygiene_seq.rs and the new test files.

issues.title: AuditReport omits incomplete signal and deadline handling on large bank scans
issues.why_it_matters: Phase 100210 Section 10 states: Scorer timeout on huge bank -> Deadline / pagination -> Return partial page + incomplete signal; do not mutate.
issues.impact: On banks with many items, hygiene_audit performs sequential N+1 item fetches without deadline enforcement or an incomplete status flag on AuditReport.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-hygiene/src/audit.rs:55-65: AuditReport struct lacks an incomplete field.
issues.proposed_fix: Add incomplete: bool to AuditReport and support deadline/cancellation handling.

issues.title: Divergence in hygiene log list field naming from requirement.md §4.9.5.A specification
issues.why_it_matters: requirement.md §4.9.5.A defines the hygiene log entry shape as {timestamp, actor, bank, action, item_ids[], noise_scores?, confirm, dry_run, result}.
issues.impact: Tool output returns database column names (created_at, bank_id, confirmed, item_id, detail.result) instead of the exact logical names defined in §4.9.5.A.
issues.proposed_fix: Add timestamp and bank aliases to HygieneLogEntry serialization or hygiene_log_list tool response.
